inquiries.title: Prospective Students
inquiries.text: Prospective students should review the Join page before contacting Dr. Shan Du. Please include your intended program, research interests, relevant background, expected start date, and the requested supporting materials.

inquiries.title: Research Collaboration
inquiries.text: Academic and industry researchers are welcome to contact the lab regarding potential collaborations related to its research areas. Please include a short description of the proposed topic and the anticipated form of collaboration.

inquiries.title: General Inquiries
inquiries.text: For other inquiries related to the laboratory, its publications, projects, or research activities, please contact Dr. Shan Du by email.
